newsitem.title: JAPAN: Olympus Optical to boost camera production abroad.
newsitem.headline: Olympus Optical to boost camera production abroad.

text.p: Olympus Optical Co Ltd said on Friday that it plans to begin making more of its expensive cameras abroad, raising the ratio of overseas production of cameras in value terms from the current 65 percent to 80 percent in the 1997/98 business year.
The company produces cameras at two locations in China and one in Hong Kong.
"Despite the recent decline of the yen against the dollar, the cost of procuring camera parts overseas remains cheaper than in Japan," said a company spokesman.
He added the company expects the yen to strengthen against the dollar again in the long term.
